Name: Location Announcer
Author: ridwan12dvk
Description:
Whenever you warp to a new location, the location name fades in at the bottom of the screen, stays for a moment, then fades out.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Shows location name on every warp — towns, farms, mines, dungeons, and modded areas[/*]
[*]Mines and Skull Cavern show the current floor: [i]The Mines — Floor 15[/i], [i]Skull Cavern — Floor 3[/i][/*]
[*]Works with modded locations — falls back to a readable version of the internal name if no display name is set[/*]
[*]Fully configurable: toggle on/off, adjust fade-in, display, and fade-out durations[/*]
[*]Optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support — change settings in-game without editing files[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already[/*]
[*]Download and unzip — copy the [b]LocationAnnouncer[/b] folder into your [b]Mods[/b] folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
SMAPI generates [b]config.json[/b] on first launch. If you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed, all settings are available in-game from the title screen.

[list]
[*][b]Enabled[/b] (default: [i]true[/i]) — Enable or disable the overlay[/*]
[*][b]DisplayDuration[/b] (default: [i]2.0s[/i]) — How long the name stays fully visible[/*]
[*][b]FadeInDuration[/b] (default: [i]0.3s[/i]) — Fade-in animation duration[/*]
[*][b]FadeOutDuration[/b] (default: [i]0.5s[/i]) — Fade-out animation duration[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Known Limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Some modded locations don't set a display name — the mod falls back to a readable version of the internal name, which may include the mod author's prefix. This can only be fixed by the mod author adding a [b]DisplayName[/b] to their location data.[/*]
[*]The Casino shows as "Club" — that's what the game's own display name returns for that location.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Location Announcer
Manifest.Description: Displays a HUD overlay with the location name when warping to a new area.
